note: Second score for Reel 3 (Ryan, 2026-10-06: use the wallpaper reel's music as the example type; music hits in line with text on screen and transitions). The feel comes from the wallpaper reel's separated music stem (measured: about 110 bpm, bass-heavy, busy rhythm, very steady level), filled in by score_music --reference-features. The groove is longer than the reel needs so conform_music can take whole bars out to fit.
global: beat-driven instrumental bed; deep sub bass; kick on the beat; hi-hats and percussion; minimal melody; consistent energy with no breakdowns; no vocals
avoid: vocals; lyrics; acoustic guitar; orchestral; cinematic trailer hits; risers; cheesy corporate

sections.name: Hit
sections.style: starts on one strong accented downbeat hit with a deep bass note; then the beat settles in

sections.name: Groove
sections.style: steady drum and bass groove; kick on every beat; busy hi-hats; deep sub bass line that repeats; same energy throughout

sections.name: Resolve
sections.style: drums stop; one final accented bass hit on the first beat that rings out and ends cleanly
